maddeler.e:
أتمنطق (form IIq)
# أَتَمَنْطَقُ (ʔatamanṭaqu) /ʔa.ta.man.tˤa.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# أُتَمَنْطَقُ (ʔutamanṭaqu) /ʔu.ta.man.tˤa.qu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# أَتَمَنْطَقَ (ʔatamanṭaqa) /ʔa.ta.man.tˤa.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# أُتَمَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
